Vesta Home, furniture rental and home staging. The archive also carries a bare 'vesta' slug from 2019 — the same company under two spellings, resolved at the identity step.

Vir Biotechnology (NASDAQ: VIR), founded 2016 by Vicki Sato and George Scangos with SoftBank and ARCH backing; IPO'd 2019. Archive-only row (2022). A public row needs a cited market cap before any band above below_1b.

Wispr AI, neural-interface and voice input, the company behind Wispr Flow. The same company as the live 'wispr-flow' row (the archive carries the corporate name, the live site the product) — a duplicate to resolve at the identity step.
Wispr Flow, voice-driven text input; the live-site row for the company the archive lists as 'wispr-ai'. Raised a $30M Series A in 2025.
Zeno, archive-only row (2021), gone from the live site; several companies use the name and none resolves against this row's evidence.
